# Hearthstone of South Weber

> Hearthstone of South Weber is a small assisted living and memory care community at 6980 South 475 East, South Weber, Utah 84405 (Davis County), near Ogden and Layton. Phone: (801) 479-6000.

## Care
- Assisted living: private studio apartments with help with bathing, dressing, transfers, and medication management.
- Memory care: a secure setting with structured routines and 24/7 supervision for residents living with Alzheimer's disease or other dementia.
- Every apartment includes a 24-hour call system with caregivers on site, three meals a day (special diets accommodated), housekeeping, and laundry.
- Wheelchair-accessible apartments and common areas; non-ambulatory care available.

## Life at Hearthstone
- Restaurant-style dining, gardens and walking paths, an activities calendar, on-site and off-site devotionals, salon and barber, furnished apartments.
- Ogden Regional Medical Center is about two miles away.

## Contact
- Tours: call (801) 479-6000. Pricing depends on the apartment and level of care; call for current availability.
- Website: https://hearthstonesouthweber.com/
